# Niltavi UI source

The product components in this directory and the files in [src/theme](../../theme) are copied from [Niltavi UI at 4b7f51a](https://github.com/niltavi/niltavi-ui/tree/4b7f51af84c60c455920363a841fb586ff224adc). The wordmark assets in [public](../../../public) match that revision. Update the component and theme files together when changing the pin.

The [MIT license](../../../public/licenses/niltavi-ui.txt) and [DM Sans font license](../../../public/licenses/dm-sans.txt) are served with the built site.
